build_curope_cuda_extension: build the curope CUDA extension by running python setup.py install in the curope directory
build_curope_for_all_archs: build the curope extension compiled for all available CUDA architectures detected by torch
review_setup_cuda_compile_args: review the setup.py nvcc and cxx compile flags used to build the curope CUDA extension
refactor_cuda_archs_manual: refactor setup.py to use a hardcoded list of CUDA architectures instead of auto-detecting all
summarize_curope_setup: summarize the curope setup.py which builds a CUDA extension from curope.cpp and kernels.cu sources
